gameplayDistinctness: Editable scrolling 16×18 maze; autonomous handed wall-following collectors, gold score multiplier, flood-fill down-exit detection, angry downward wall-breaking, negative escape scores and scroll acceleration, missed-gold loss. No finite maze corpus or renamed variant.
reviewedGameSource: Complete main reviewed before any game execution: arithmetic, original Vector/grid operations, input, drawing, particles, score/audio and original game termination only. No IO, imports, eval, DOM, storage or timers.
runtime: Existing audited local crisp-game-lib 1.0.2 and sounds-some-sounds 2.0.0 with lifecycle integration. No new library or installer.
dependencyReview: Read existing source map, source manifests, complete shipped licenses and engine/audio/mml package metadata; reuse pinned engine/audio/jsfx/mml sources and existing source correspondence.
optionalModes: Default simple canvas theme. Procedural characters, BGM and SFX active; replay and front-drawn score enabled. No Pixi/GIF/minify/rewind mode.
network: Original main has no external IO. All iframe references are local; CSP blocks all connections.
upstreamKnownQuirksPreserved: checkDownExit performs exactly nine paired scan sweeps rather than an unbounded graph traversal; its original reachable-path decision is unchanged.
The scrolling update shifts at most one grid row per frame, including the unusually fast opening scroll and accumulated escape scroll.
A held pointer can toggle a revisited cell after visiting a different one. Only the previous cell is suppressed, and gold-bearing cells cannot be edited.

Escapes decrement an elevated multiplier before deducting that multiplier; a run with genuinely collected gold may finish at zero or below. Best score records the final run, not its highest intermediate score.
testing: Only static integrity/syntax/XML checks performed here. Single targeted real desktop/mobile E2E authored for parent CI. No upstream game execution, installation, unit tests, old solvers or artificial outcomes.
syntax: PASS: node --check parsed both original main and observer without executing them
svg: PASS: XML parse via static source checker
build: NOT_RUN: isolated files are not registered in integration checkout
browserE2E: NOT_RUN: final parent CI required; real-input strategy must be validated there
sourceIntegrity: PASS: original main and full MIT byte counts, SHA-256, Git blob hashes, CRLF and runtime/vendor equality
resourceIntegrity: PASS: iframe resources resolve locally against staging/shared root; CSP blocks external connections
